# Furry Puppet Studio

> Custom puppets & characters for film, TV & live events - designed and built in-house by Furry Puppet Studio, a NYC custom puppet maker.

## About

> We create iconic puppets for clients around the world spanning a myriad of industries, most notably the TV, music, and the ad industry.
> Our team enjoys being involved throughout the entire creative process, overseeing both character design and puppet fabrication to ensure each creation uniquely embodies our clients' visions, and our signature style.

We pride ourselves on our ability to design and fabricate custom puppets in a variety of styles: hand puppets, mascot costumes, marionettes, and animatronic creature effects.

### Client Showcase

[![Screenshot of the Apple Japan website - showcasing custom lookalike puppets designed in New York by Furry Puppet Studio](https://www.furrypuppet.com/media/Apple-Japan-Puppets-1-1000x734.jpg)](https://www.furrypuppet.com/blog/apple-japan/)

### Apple Japan

For two years we worked with Apple's team on their iPhone campaign in Japan. [Learn More](https://www.furrypuppet.com/blog/apple-japan/)

**Services**:
- Character design
- Puppet fabrication
- Art direction on set
- Puppeteering

### Missy Elliott

We created marionettes in the likeness of Pharrell Williams and Missy Elliott for their award winning Music Video, WTF. [Learn More](https://www.furrypuppet.com/blog/missy-elliotts-back/)

**Services**:
- Character design
- Puppet fabrication
- Costume design

[![Missy Eliott - WTF Marionettes](https://www.furrypuppet.com/media/Missy-Elliott-WTF-Marionettes-10.jpg)](https://www.furrypuppet.com/blog/missy-elliotts-back/) [![Huge monster puppet design, as it is being fabricated in Brooklyn, NY](https://www.furrypuppet.com/media/Huge-monster-puppet-design-1000x992.jpg)](https://www.furrypuppet.com/blog/casper_puppets/)

### Casper

We created the the monster puppets for Casper's first TV campaign. [Learn More](https://www.furrypuppet.com/blog/casper_puppets/)

**Services**:
- Character design
- Puppet fabrication
- Puppeteering
